tools.Name: MathModelAgent
tools.Description: An agent designed for automated mathematical modeling, coding, and paper generation.
tools.Use_Case: Automating the completion of complex mathematical modeling tasks and generating submission-ready research papers.

tools.Name: Scrapling
tools.Description: An adaptive Web Scraping framework that features smart element tracking, stealthy fetching, and auto-scaling.
tools.Use_Case: Handling simple requests to full-scale concurrent crawls while bypassing anti-bot systems like Cloudflare.

tools.Name: oMLX
tools.Description: An optimized LLM inference server for Apple Silicon featuring continuous batching, tiered KV caching, and a macOS menu bar controller.
tools.Use_Case: Running local LLMs and VLMs efficiently on Mac hardware for coding agents or personal use with persistent context.
